title: Two marks in sediment

doesNotKnow: In the model the lower mark was covered before the upper mark formed. A layer can accumulate over an interval rather than in one instant. Real accumulation rates and interruptions require independent evidence.

misconception: The first apparent interpretation is the only possible one.
objective: A modeled sediment layer contains marks formed before and after later material settled on top. Does the whole layer represent one instant?
